text:
elena-sales: Quick heads-up, Contoso needs an MSA + DPA redline review today and procurement wants PO mapping. This is blocking POC kickoff next week. Can legal weigh in on acceptability? @maria-legal

maria-legal: I'm on it. Main asks so far: remove the limited exception in section 7.2, add a data residency clause limiting EU data to EU infrastructure, and confirm they accept our KMS/HSM addendum. If they push for alternate language, ask them to upload a redline.

jake-ops: Procurement: they asked for net45 and a vendor W-9. For the POC we can accept net30 or net45 but production invoicing requires W-9 and PO # on invoice. If they need the POC immediately, we can do the trial on credits and mark the SOW as $0 until PO is issued.

anna-customer: Confirmed on Contoso side: PO will likely be 10 business days. We can sign SOW today to begin. Legal will need to review MSA but can delay final MSA signature until buy-in.

sam-se: Practical path to unblock: 1) Send DPA + short POC SOW for signature today (SOW priced $0) 2) Provide hosted eval credits and sandbox access 3) Start POC next week. If they insist on MSA redlines we ask for their redline file and continue the POC in parallel.

chris-security: FYI Contoso's sec questionnaire flagged BYOK and SOC2 requirements. We have SOC2 Type II and ISO docs; I'll attach certs to the DocuSign packet. Regarding BYOK: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS. Hosted requires an exception and we can offer a KMS bridge for the trial. Need confirmation whether Contoso requires BYOK for the POC or only production.

maria-legal: We can approve SOW + DPA for the trial if DPA contains standard data controller instructions and a 15-day deletion timeline after termination. I'll prep a short redline and upload to Drive. Also clarify which person at Contoso will sign MSA vs SOW.

elena-sales: Anna, who will sign which doc? Also, do they use DocuSign? We need envelope routing.

anna-customer: They use DocuSign. I'm the technical contact and can route the SOW. Legal signs the MSA. For the trial, legal said they can circulate the DPA to expedite.

jake-ops: Operational notes: set SOW amount to $0, include a PO-pending line and placeholder for PO #45678 to fill later. W-9 must be received before any billed production run. Ops-bot: reserve eval capacity on Wed 09:00-17:00 UTC pending signed SOW.

ops-bot: Reserved eval capacity created (ID: eval-786). Reminder: sandbox provisioning requires signed SOW in DocuSign.

sam-se: I'll provision the sandbox once DPA+SOW are signed. Suggested billing clause for SOW to prevent accidental charges:

```
Billing: Trial period (specified in SOW) is non-billable. No charges will be invoiced until Customer authorizes move to production and an order form is executed.
```

maria-legal: That clause is acceptable. One tweak: add explicit "no charge" line and retention of rights to invoice for any optional paid addons opted-in. Also tighten deletion to 15 days for PII. I'll upload the DPA/DOC redline to Drive and share link here.

elena-sales: Plan: send DPA + POC SOW (zero-dollar) + SOC2 certs and sandbox access link. Tag this thread with the DocuSign envelope ID once sent. Contingency: if Contoso insists on MSA redlines immediately, request their redline doc and continue POC in parallel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
